goal: Replace native <select> matching with a polished, accessible drag-and-drop card-pairing UI.
summary: Phase 2 completed: built a premium MatchingQuestion component with drag-and-drop (pointer events), touch tap-to-match fallback, keyboard navigation (Tab/Arrows/Enter/Escape), haptic feedback via navigator.vibrate, SVG connector lines, screen-reader announcements via aria-live, Framer Motion animations, and post-submission correction display. Integrated into QuizInterface.tsx (replacing native <select>) and ResultsDashboard.tsx (read-only review mode). Wrote 15 comprehensive unit tests covering rendering, tap matching, keyboard navigation, submission, disabled state, and post-submission styling. All 43 tests pass. Committed as 00758e9.
